verdict.rationale: Bitbucket ships its own automation layer, Bitbucket Pipelines, including AI-powered pipeline workflows. It is also a version-control and code-review platform with PR review and merge checks. However, the evidence never states that automation definitions are versioned in the repo, reviewed via PRs, or can be rolled back; that link is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that pipeline/automation configs are stored and versioned as code, a documented review flow for automation changes, any documented rollback of automations or deployments, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
